verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs describe DLSS Multi Frame Generation, path tracing via Blackwell RT cores, and Reflex latency tech that underpin 4K high-refresh gaming performance claims, but these are all vendor marketing pages. The lone independent source is a TechPowerUp review of an AIB card that only discusses cooling and price, not actual 4K benchmark FPS numbers or corroboration of the vendor's performance claims. Missing for 10: independent game benchmark data validating actual 4K/high-refresh FPS, side-by-side comparisons against vendor claims, and broader outlet consensus beyond one thermal/price-focused review.
